records.name: dg6
records.description: A 1024x1024 dungeon backdrop texture used as the dungeon image for the Cave (洞窟), Deep Forest Cave (森奥の洞窟), Echidna (エキドナ) and Toutetsu (トウテツ) dungeons, the last two in the Conquest group.

records.name: dg7
records.description: A 1024x1024 dungeon backdrop texture used for the Spire (尖塔) dungeon and its Normal/Retry mode, the Disaster-tagged Agonis (アゴニス) encounter, and the Bell Tower (鐘楼塔) dungeon.

records.name: dg8
records.description: A 1024x1024 dungeon backdrop texture used for the Temple Ruins (神殿跡) dungeon, the Disaster-tagged Frauss (フラウス) encounter, and the Conquest dungeons Archangel (アークエンジェル) and Bishop Rōzuru (司教ローズル).

records.name: dg9
records.description: A 1024x1024 dungeon backdrop texture used for the Ruins (遺跡) dungeon and its Normal/Retry mode, and for the Conquest dungeons Pazuzu (パズズ) and Ifrit (イフリート).

records.name: docter
records.description: A 512x512 image shown on the four story-introduction event nodes titled "Beginning the first adventure" (REMAIN01N1 to REMAIN01N4); the row does not say what the picture depicts.

records.name: fraus.221108x512-Disaster
records.description: A 512x512 image of Frauss (フラウス), the Disaster-category foe, from the disaster table, which also appears on the event node "Case: Holy Priest Tobia 2" (ケース 聖司祭トビア 2).

records.name: fraus.221108x512
records.description: A 512x512 image of Frauss (フラウス), the enemy row Disaster-category, rarity 9, Uber-tagged foe, which is also shown on the Temple Ruins event node "Devout Believer" (神殿跡 「敬虔な信徒」).
